title: The Book of James Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of James — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad, greeting.
verses.decoded: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes scattered everywhere, greetings.

verses.kjv: My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations;
verses.decoded: My brothers and sisters, consider it pure joy when you face many kinds of troubles.

verses.kjv: Knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh patience.
verses.decoded: You know that the testing of your faith produces patience.

verses.kjv: But let patience have her perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing.
verses.decoded: Let patience finish its work so that you may be mature and complete, not lacking anything.

verses.kjv: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
verses.decoded: If any of you lacks wisdom, ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and it will be given to you.

verses.kjv: But let him ask in faith, nothing wavering. For he that wavereth is like a wave of the sea driven with the wind and tossed.
verses.decoded: But when you ask, you must believe and not doubt, because the one who doubts is like a wave of the sea, blown and tossed by the wind.

verses.kjv: For let not that man think that he shall receive any thing of the Lord.
verses.decoded: That person should not expect to receive anything from the Lord.

verses.kjv: A double minded man is unstable in all his ways.
verses.decoded: Such a person is double-minded and unstable in all they do.

verses.kjv: Let the brother of low degree rejoice in that he is exalted:
verses.decoded: Believers who are poor should take pride in their high position.

verses.kjv: But the rich, in that he is made low: because as the flower of the grass he shall pass away.
verses.decoded: But the rich should take pride in their low position, because they will fade away like a wild flower.

verses.kjv: For the sun is no sooner risen with a burning heat, but it withereth the grass, and the flower thereof falleth, and the grace of the fashion of it perisheth: so also shall the rich man fade away in his ways.
verses.decoded: For the sun rises with scorching heat and withers the plant; its flower falls and its beauty is destroyed. In the same way, the rich will fade away even while they go about their business.

verses.kjv: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord hath promised to them that love him.
verses.decoded: Blessed is the one who perseveres under trial because, having stood the test, that person will receive the crown of life that the Lord has promised to those who love him.

verses.kjv: Let no man say when he is tempted, I am tempted of God: for God cannot be tempted with evil, neither tempteth he any man:
verses.decoded: When tempted, no one should say, 'God is tempting me.' For God cannot be tempted by evil, nor does he tempt anyone.

verses.kjv: But every man is tempted, when he is drawn away of his own lust, and enticed.
verses.decoded: But each person is tempted when they are dragged away by their own evil desire and enticed.

verses.kjv: Then when lust hath conceived, it bringeth forth sin: and sin, when it is finished, bringeth forth death.
verses.decoded: Then, after desire has conceived, it gives birth to sin; and sin, when it is full-grown, gives birth to death.

verses.kjv: Do not err, my beloved brethren.
verses.decoded: Don’t make any mistakes, my dear brothers and sisters.

verses.kjv: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.
verses.decoded: Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of the heavenly lights, who does not change like shifting shadows.

verses.kjv: Of his own will begat he us with the word of truth, that we should be a kind of firstfruits of his creatures.
verses.decoded: He chose to give us birth through the word of truth, that we might be a kind of firstfruits of all he created.

verses.kjv: Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath:
verses.decoded: My dear brothers and sisters, take note of this: Everyone should be quick to listen, slow to speak and slow to become angry.

verses.kjv: For the wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God.
verses.decoded: Human anger does not produce the righteousness that God desires.

verses.kjv: Wherefore lay apart all filthiness and superfluity of naughtiness, and receive with meekness the engrafted word, which is able to save your souls.
verses.decoded: So get rid of all moral filth and the evil that is so common, and humbly accept the word planted in you, which can save you.

verses.kjv: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
verses.decoded: Do not merely listen to the word, and so deceive yourselves. Do what it says.

verses.kjv: For if any be a hearer of the word, and not a doer, he is like unto a man beholding his natural face in a glass:
verses.decoded: Anyone who listens to the word but does not do what it says is like someone who looks at his face in a mirror

verses.kjv: For he beholdeth himself, and goeth his way, and straightway forgetteth what manner of man he was.
verses.decoded: and, after looking at himself, goes away and immediately forgets what he looks like.

verses.kjv: But whoso looketh into the perfect law of liberty, and continueth therein, he being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work, this man shall be blessed in his deed.
verses.decoded: But whoever looks intently into the perfect law that gives freedom, and continues in it—not forgetting what they have heard, but doing it—they will be blessed in what they do.

verses.kjv: If any man among you seem to be religious, and bridleth not his tongue, but deceiveth his own heart, this man's religion is vain.
verses.decoded: Those who consider themselves religious and yet do not keep a tight rein on their tongues deceive themselves, and their religion is worthless.

verses.kjv: Pure religion and undefiled before God and the Father is this, To visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep himself unspotted from the world.
verses.decoded: Religion that God our Father accepts as pure and faultless is this: to look after orphans and widows in their distress and to keep oneself from being polluted by the world.

verses.kjv: My brethren, have not the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Lord of glory, with respect of persons.
verses.decoded: My brothers and sisters, don’t treat people differently when you believe in our Lord Jesus Christ, the glorious Lord.

verses.kjv: For if there come unto your assembly a man with a gold ring, in goodly apparel, and there come in also a poor man in vile raiment;
verses.decoded: Suppose a man with a gold ring and fine clothes comes into your meeting, and also a poor man in dirty clothes.

verses.kjv: And ye have respect to him that weareth the gay clothing, and say unto him, Sit thou here in a good place; and say to the poor, Stand thou there, or sit here under my footstool:
verses.decoded: If you pay attention to the man wearing fine clothes and say to him, 'Sit here in a good place,' but say to the poor man, 'Stand there,' or 'Sit on the floor by my feet,'

verses.kjv: Are ye not then partial in yourselves, and are become judges of evil thoughts?
verses.decoded: aren’t you showing favoritism and judging with wrong thoughts?

verses.kjv: Hearken, my beloved brethren, Hath not God chosen the poor of this world rich in faith, and heirs of the kingdom which he hath promised to them that love him?
verses.decoded: Listen, my dear brothers and sisters: Hasn’t God chosen those who are poor in this world to be rich in faith and to inherit the kingdom He promised to those who love Him?

verses.kjv: But ye have despised the poor. Do not rich men oppress you, and draw you before the judgment seats?
verses.decoded: But you have insulted the poor. Don’t rich people oppress you and bring you to court?

verses.kjv: Do not they blaspheme that worthy name by the which ye are called?
verses.decoded: Don’t they insult the honorable name you belong to?

verses.kjv: If ye fulfil the royal law according to the scripture, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself, ye do well:
verses.decoded: If you obey the royal law found in the Scriptures, 'Love your neighbor as yourself,' you are doing right.

verses.kjv: But if ye have respect to persons, ye commit sin, and are convinced of the law as transgressors.
verses.decoded: But if you show favoritism, you sin and are convicted by the law as lawbreakers.

verses.kjv: For whosoever shall keep the whole law, and yet offend in one point, he is guilty of all.
verses.decoded: For whoever keeps the whole law but fails in one point is guilty of breaking all of it.

verses.kjv: For he that said, Do not commit adultery, said also, Do not kill. Now if thou commit no adultery, yet if thou kill, thou art become a transgressor of the law.
verses.decoded: The one who said, 'Do not commit adultery,' also said, 'Do not kill.' If you don’t commit adultery but do kill, you have broken the law.

verses.kjv: So speak ye, and so do, as they that shall be judged by the law of liberty.
verses.decoded: Speak and act as those who will be judged by the law that gives freedom.

verses.kjv: For he shall have judgment without mercy, that hath shewed no mercy; and mercy rejoiceth against judgment.
verses.decoded: Because judgment without mercy will be shown to anyone who has not been merciful. Mercy triumphs over judgment.

verses.kjv: What doth it profit, my brethren, though a man say he hath faith, and have not works? can faith save him?
verses.decoded: What good is it, my brothers and sisters, if someone claims to have faith but has no actions? Can that faith save them?

verses.kjv: If a brother or sister be naked, and destitute of daily food,
verses.decoded: If a brother or sister is without clothes and daily food,

verses.kjv: And one of you say unto them, Depart in peace, be ye warmed and filled; notwithstanding ye give them not those things which are needful to the body; what doth it profit?
verses.decoded: and one of you says to them, 'Go in peace, stay warm, and eat well,' but does nothing to help their physical needs, what good is it?

verses.kjv: Even so faith, if it hath not works, is dead, being alone.
verses.decoded: In the same way, faith by itself, if it is not accompanied by actions, is dead.

verses.kjv: Yea, a man may say, Thou hast faith, and I have works: shew me thy faith without thy works, and I will shew thee my faith by my works.
verses.decoded: But someone will say, 'You have faith; I have actions.' Show me your faith without actions, and I will show you my faith by my actions.

verses.kjv: Thou believest that there is one God; thou doest well: the devils also believe, and tremble.
verses.decoded: You believe that there is one God. Good! Even the demons believe that—and they shudder.

verses.kjv: But wilt thou know, O vain man, that faith without works is dead?
verses.decoded: You foolish person, do you want proof that faith without actions is useless?

verses.kjv: Seest thou how faith wrought with his works, and by works was faith made perfect?
verses.decoded: You see that faith and actions worked together, and faith was made complete by what he did.

verses.kjv: And the scripture was fulfilled which saith, Abraham believed God, and it was imputed unto him for righteousness: and he was called the Friend of God.
verses.decoded: And the Scripture was fulfilled that says, 'Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness,' and he was called God’s friend.

verses.kjv: Ye see then how that by works a man is justified, and not by faith only.
verses.decoded: You see that a person is made right with God by what they do, not by faith alone.

verses.kjv: Likewise also was not Rahab the harlot justified by works, when she had received the messengers, and had sent them out another way?
verses.decoded: In the same way, wasn’t Rahab the prostitute made right with God by her actions when she welcomed the messengers and sent them out another way?

verses.kjv: For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also.
verses.decoded: Just as the body without the spirit is dead, faith without actions is dead too.

verses.kjv: My brethren, be not many masters, knowing that we shall receive the greater condemnation.
verses.decoded: My brothers and sisters, do not become many teachers, because we will be judged more strictly.

verses.kjv: For in many things we offend all. If any man offend not in word, the same is a perfect man, and able also to bridle the whole body.
verses.decoded: We all make mistakes in many ways. If anyone does not make mistakes in what they say, that person is mature and able to control their whole body.

verses.kjv: Behold, we put bits in the horses' mouths, that they may obey us; and we turn about their whole body.
verses.decoded: Think about this: we put bits in horses’ mouths to make them obey us, and we can turn their whole bodies.

verses.kjv: Behold also the ships, which though they be so great, and are driven of fierce winds, yet are they turned about with a very small helm, whithersoever the governor listeth.
verses.decoded: Also think about ships. Even though they are very large and are driven by strong winds, they are turned by a very small rudder wherever the pilot wants.

verses.kjv: Even so the tongue is a little member, and boasteth great things. Behold, how great a matter a little fire kindleth!
verses.decoded: In the same way, the tongue is a small part of the body but boasts great things. See how a small fire can start a big blaze!

verses.kjv: And the tongue is a fire, a world of iniquity: so is the tongue among our members, that it defileth the whole body, and setteth on fire the course of nature; and it is set on fire of hell.
verses.decoded: The tongue is like a fire, a world of evil among our parts. It pollutes the whole body and sets the course of life on fire, and it is itself set on fire by hell.

verses.kjv: For every kind of beasts, and of birds, and of serpents, and of things in the sea, is tamed, and hath been tamed of mankind:
verses.decoded: All kinds of animals, birds, snakes, and sea creatures can be controlled and have been controlled by humans.

verses.kjv: But the tongue can no man tame; it is an unruly evil, full of deadly poison.
verses.decoded: But no one can control the tongue. It is an uncontrollable evil, full of deadly poison.

verses.kjv: Therewith bless we God, even the Father; and therewith curse we men, which are made after the similitude of God.
verses.decoded: With the tongue we praise God, our Father, and with it we curse people who are made in God’s image.

verses.kjv: Out of the same mouth proceedeth blessing and cursing. My brethren, these things ought not so to be.
verses.decoded: From the same mouth come blessing and cursing. My brothers and sisters, this should not happen.

verses.kjv: Doth a fountain send forth at the same place sweet water and bitter?
verses.decoded: Does a spring send out fresh water and bitter water from the same place?

verses.kjv: Can the fig tree, my brethren, bear olive berries? either a vine, figs? so can no fountain both yield salt water and fresh.
verses.decoded: Can a fig tree produce olives, my brothers and sisters? Can a grapevine produce figs? Neither can a spring produce both salt water and fresh water.

verses.kjv: Who is a wise man and endued with knowledge among you? let him shew out of a good conversation his works with meekness of wisdom.
verses.decoded: Who among you is wise and has knowledge? Let that person show by good behavior that their works are done with humility and wisdom.

verses.kjv: But if ye have bitter envying and strife in your hearts, glory not, and lie not against the truth.
verses.decoded: But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your hearts, don’t brag or lie against the truth.

verses.kjv: This wisdom descendeth not from above, but is earthly, sensual, devilish.
verses.decoded: That kind of wisdom does not come from heaven but is earthly, natural, and demonic.

verses.kjv: For where envying and strife is, there is confusion and every evil work.
verses.decoded: Where there is jealousy and selfish ambition, there is confusion and every kind of evil.

verses.kjv: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, and easy to be intreated, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.
verses.decoded: But the wisdom from above is pure, peaceful, gentle, willing to yield, full of mercy and good fruit, without favoritism and without hypocrisy.

verses.kjv: And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace of them that make peace.
verses.decoded: And those who make peace will plant seeds of righteousness and reap a harvest of peace.

verses.kjv: From whence come wars and fightings among you? come they not hence, even of your lusts that war in your members?
verses.decoded: Where do the wars and fights among you come from? Don't they come from your own desires fighting inside you?

verses.kjv: Ye lust, and have not: ye kill, and desire to have, and cannot obtain: ye fight and war, yet ye have not, because ye ask not.
verses.decoded: You want something but don't get it; you kill and crave to have, but you cannot get it. You fight and war, but you still don't have it because you don't ask.

verses.kjv: Ye ask, and receive not, because ye ask amiss, that ye may consume it upon your lusts.
verses.decoded: You ask but don't receive because you ask with wrong motives, wanting to use it for your own pleasures.

verses.kjv: Ye adulterers and adulteresses, know ye not that the friendship of the world is enmity with God? whosoever therefore will be a friend of the world is the enemy of God.
verses.decoded: You people who are unfaithful, don't you know that being a friend of the world makes you an enemy of God? So anyone who wants to be a friend of the world becomes God's enemy.

verses.kjv: Do ye think that the scripture saith in vain, The spirit that dwelleth in us lusteth to envy?
verses.decoded: Do you think the scripture says for no reason, 'The spirit that lives in us wants to envy'?

verses.kjv: But he giveth more grace. Wherefore he saith, God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace unto the humble.
verses.decoded: But God gives more grace. That is why the scripture says, 'God opposes the proud but gives grace to the humble.'

verses.kjv: Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
verses.decoded: So submit yourselves to God. Resist the devil, and he will run away from you.

verses.kjv: Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye double minded.
verses.decoded: Come close to God, and he will come close to you. Clean your hands, you sinners, and purify your hearts, you who have divided loyalties.

verses.kjv: Be afflicted, and mourn, and weep: let your laughter be turned to mourning, and your joy to heaviness.
verses.decoded: Be sad, mourn, and cry. Let your laughter turn to sadness and your joy to sorrow.

verses.kjv: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he shall lift you up.
verses.decoded: Humble yourselves before the Lord, and he will lift you up.

verses.kjv: Speak not evil one of another, brethren. He that speaketh evil of his brother, and judgeth his brother, speaketh evil of the law, and judgeth the law: but if thou judge the law, thou art not a doer of the law, but a judge.
verses.decoded: Don't speak evil against each other, brothers and sisters. Anyone who speaks evil against a brother or judges him speaks evil against the law and judges the law. But if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law but a judge.

verses.kjv: There is one lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy: who art thou that judgest another?
verses.decoded: There is only one lawgiver and judge who can save and destroy. Who are you to judge someone else?

verses.kjv: Go to now, ye that say, To day or to morrow we will go into such a city, and continue there a year, and buy and sell, and get gain:
verses.decoded: Now listen, you who say, 'Today or tomorrow we will go to this city, stay there a year, buy and sell, and make a profit.'

verses.kjv: Whereas ye know not what shall be on the morrow. For what is your life? It is even a vapour, that appeareth for a little time, and then vanisheth away.
verses.decoded: You don't even know what will happen tomorrow. What is your life? It is like a mist that appears for a little while and then disappears.

verses.kjv: For that ye ought to say, If the Lord will, we shall live, and do this, or that.
verses.decoded: Instead, you should say, 'If the Lord wants, we will live and do this or that.'

verses.kjv: But now ye rejoice in your boastings: all such rejoicing is evil.
verses.decoded: But now you boast in your arrogance. All such boasting is evil.

verses.kjv: Therefore to him that knoweth to do good, and doeth it not, to him it is sin.
verses.decoded: So, if anyone knows the right thing to do and doesn't do it, it is a sin for them.

verses.kjv: Go to now, ye rich men, weep and howl for your miseries that shall come upon you.
verses.decoded: Now listen, rich people, cry and wail because of the troubles coming to you.

verses.kjv: Your riches are corrupted, and your garments are motheaten.
verses.decoded: Your wealth is spoiled, and your clothes are eaten by moths.

verses.kjv: Your gold and silver is cankered; and the rust of them shall be a witness against you, and shall eat your flesh as it were fire. Ye have heaped treasure together for the last days.
verses.decoded: Your gold and silver are rusted; that rust will prove against you and destroy your flesh like fire. You have stored up treasure for the last days.

verses.kjv: Behold, the hire of the labourers who have reaped down your fields, which is of you kept back by fraud, crieth: and the cries of them which have reaped are entered into the ears of the Lord of sabaoth.
verses.decoded: Look, the wages of the workers who harvested your fields, which you kept back by cheating, are crying out. The cries of those who harvested have reached the ears of the Lord of Heaven’s Armies.

verses.kjv: Ye have lived in pleasure on the earth, and been wanton; ye have nourished your hearts, as in a day of slaughter.
verses.decoded: You have lived in luxury on earth and indulged yourselves. You have fattened your hearts like on a day of slaughter.

verses.kjv: Ye have condemned and killed the just; and he doth not resist you.
verses.decoded: You have condemned and murdered the innocent, and they did not resist you.

verses.kjv: Be patient therefore, brethren, unto the coming of the Lord. Behold, the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, and hath long patience for it, until he receive the early and latter rain.
verses.decoded: So be patient, brothers and sisters, until the Lord comes. Farmers wait patiently for the valuable crop from the land, being patient with it until it receives the early and late rains.

verses.kjv: Be ye also patient; stablish your hearts: for the coming of the Lord draweth nigh.
verses.decoded: You also be patient. Strengthen your hearts, because the coming of the Lord is near.

verses.kjv: Grudge not one against another, brethren, lest ye be condemned: behold, the judge standeth before the door.
verses.decoded: Don’t complain against each other, brothers and sisters, or you will be judged. Look, the Judge is standing at the door.

verses.kjv: Take, my brethren, the prophets, who have spoken in the name of the Lord, for an example of suffering affliction, and of patience.
verses.decoded: Take as an example of suffering and patience the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.

verses.kjv: Behold, we count them happy which endure. Ye have heard of the patience of Job, and have seen the end of the Lord; that the Lord is very pitiful, and of tender mercy.
verses.decoded: We consider those who endure to be happy. You have heard about Job’s patience and have seen the outcome the Lord gave, that the Lord is full of compassion and mercy.

verses.kjv: But above all things, my brethren, swear not, neither by heaven, neither by the earth, neither by any other oath: but let your yea be yea; and your nay, nay; lest ye fall into condemnation.
verses.decoded: Above all, my brothers and sisters, don’t swear by heaven, earth, or anything else. Let your yes be yes, and your no be no, so you don’t fall under judgment.

verses.kjv: Is any among you afflicted? let him pray. Is any merry? let him sing psalms.
verses.decoded: Is anyone suffering? Let them pray. Is anyone happy? Let them sing praises.

verses.kjv: Is any sick among you? let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord:
verses.decoded: Is anyone sick? Let them call the elders of the church to pray over them and anoint them with oil in the name of the Lord.

verses.kjv: And the prayer of faith shall save the sick, and the Lord shall raise him up; and if he have committed sins, they shall be forgiven him.
verses.decoded: The prayer of faith will save the sick, and the Lord will raise them up. If they have sinned, they will be forgiven.

verses.kjv: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.
verses.decoded: Confess your sins to each other and pray for each other so you may be healed. The earnest prayer of a righteous person has great power.

verses.kjv: Elias was a man subject to like passions as we are, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain: and it rained not on the earth by the space of three years and six months.
verses.decoded: Elijah was a man just like us. He prayed earnestly that it would not rain, and it did not rain for three and a half years.

verses.kjv: And he prayed again, and the heaven gave rain, and the earth brought forth her fruit.
verses.decoded: Then he prayed again, and the sky gave rain, and the earth produced its crops.

verses.kjv: Brethren, if any of you do err from the truth, and one convert him;
verses.decoded: My brothers and sisters, if anyone wanders away from the truth and someone brings them back,

verses.kjv: Let him know, that he which converteth the sinner from the error of his way shall save a soul from death, and shall hide a multitude of sins.
verses.decoded: remember that whoever turns a sinner from their wrong way will save them from death and cover a multitude of sins.
